roles.purpose: Audit CoachAI's semantic pipeline so grounded AI owns coaching meaning, deterministic code remains a validation backstop, bounded repair stays truthful, coaching sensitivity reaches every surface, and paid provider calls remain metered.
trigger: before merging analysis, prompt, semantic-judgment, scoring, coaching-generation, or paid-model changes
required_outputs: semantic and metering invariants checked and found clean

roles.purpose: Find contradictions between CoachAI code and its settled decision log, AI decision-matrix register, authority tiers, central registries, and source-of-truth maps, including contradictions between doctrine artifacts.
trigger: before merging behavior governed by a decision-log row, AI-matrix entry, authority tier, or central registry
required_outputs: doctrine artifacts and behaviors checked and found consistent

roles.purpose: Trace CoachAI's authoritative evidence and derived state through persistence, DTOs, mappers, and final surfaces while checking lifecycle safety, anti-fabrication, useful coaching, reanalysis replacement, and route-artifact parity.
trigger: before merging DTO, mapper, coaching-entity, persisted-derived-state, manager-surface, or visible coaching changes
required_outputs: source-to-screen and lifecycle findings with file-line evidence
chains and lifecycles traced and found clean

roles.purpose: Run CoachAI's named verification battery as the sole local or disposable test-database user, preserve real exits and nonzero summaries, and return a compact failure diagnosis without editing.
trigger: after a finished CoachAI slice requires its named heavy verification battery
required_outputs: one root cause and suggested fix per failure
